title: An Average Afternoon
request: Count the reading times that are at least the mean of this tray. An exactly average afternoon still counts.
objective: Reduce an array, compare element-wise, and count True values.
starter:
import numpy as np
count = 0
deliver(count)
hints: Compute how many values in times are at least the average of the tray.
Use np.mean(times) for the average, >= for an inclusive comparison, and np.count_nonzero to count True values.
Write average = np.mean(times), then count = np.count_nonzero(times >= ___) and deliver(count).
inputCode:
import random
from datascience import make_array
times = make_array(*[random.randint(1, 30) for _ in range(random.randint(2, 8))])
reference:
import numpy as np
average = np.mean(times)
count = np.count_nonzero(times >= average)
deliver(count)

naive.code:
import numpy as np
deliver(np.count_nonzero(times > np.mean(times)))
